title: test(ui): run the kept Console live specs nightly; delete the stale and duplicated ones
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MogRN1CAWpndKB1euF4K8n)_

Fixes #25914

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:18 个不在任何 CI 里跑的 Console live spec 逐个实跑;15 个绿的进 Nightly Tiers(一个 vitest 包装 + `ui/package.json` 一行脚本),删掉 2 个过时的红 spec 和 1 个与 showcase 夜间 smoke 重复的 spec,并改正引用它们的检查单条目。
- 为什么改:裁决 Q3 B:过时的删,其余接入 Nightly Tiers,红了由该 job 的 report 步骤自动建卡;MSW 那条空测试已被 #26032 删除,这里顺手去掉它留下的 MSW 报错豁免。
- 风险与回滚:只动测试和检查单,不改产品代码,也不碰 4 个必跑 spec 和 `Live E2E UI` job;夜间 showcase 分片多约 5 分钟;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`examples/app-showcase/test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts`,以及下面的逐 spec 表。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui run test:e2e:live:nightly --list`,预期列出 15 个文件、25 个用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Each of the 18 live specs outside `test:e2e:live:ci` was run alone against the workspace showcase backend (`ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, the boot the required job uses) at `origin/main` `1e8e5296`. Both reds were run a second time and failed the same way.

| Spec | Result | Outcome |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `cascading-options` | 2 passed | kept, nightly |
| `declared-sharing-rules-reach-13091` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `detail-related-list` | failed: `waitForURL(/record/)` timeout | deleted, stale |
| `field-conditional-rules` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `form-view-subforms` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `grid-conditional-rules` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `grid-file-upload` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `grid-parent-rules` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `inline-edit-polish-2572` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `list-row-action-cel` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `record-history-display` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `required-when-submit` | 1 passed | kept, nightly |
| `showcase-smoke` | 29 passed (104 s) | deleted, duplicate |
| `studio-editor` | 2 passed | kept, nightly |
| `studio-object-designer` | 4 passed | kept, nightly |
| `studio-record-page` | failed: `blocks.length` 0 | deleted, stale |
| `summary-rollup` | 2 passed | kept, nightly |
| `user-filters` | 5 passed | kept, nightly |

- **Wiring (route A, amendment 6470826683), not Tier H.**
  - `ui/package.json` gains one script, `test:e2e:live:nightly`, that lists the 15 kept specs.
  - `examples/app-showcase/test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` is a `*.live.test.ts` file, so Nightly Tiers already selects it in the showcase shard, which builds the Console and installs Chromium. Its report step files a card on red.
  - The wrapper follows `showcase-smoke.live.test.ts`:
    - It boots the backend with `start-backend.sh`.
    - It builds the Console with `VITE_BASE_PATH=/` into a scratch dir and serves it with `vite preview` plus `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`. The specs `goto` root `/apps/...`, which neither the default `./` base nor the `/_console` copy serves.
    - It runs the script with a JSON reporter and fails, naming every failing spec, unless all of them passed.
    - It stops the preview and the backend by PID in `finally`.
  - No `.github/workflows/**` edit, and `ci.yml` and `ui/.github/**` are untouched.
- **`showcase-smoke` is a duplicate.** `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` already runs nightly through `showcase-smoke.live.test.ts`.
  - Every one of the deleted spec's 29 surface paths is in the kept spec, which has 49 (`comm -23` of the two path lists is empty; one label changed from "Settings (preference)" to "Settings" on the same path).
  - The kept spec makes each of the deleted spec's four assertions: no uncaught page error, no leaked "no actions configured" placeholder, non-empty main content, and a chart SVG with width and height above 0. It is stricter on two: it requires a chart width above 200, and it refuses a surface that is still on the boot splash.
- **`studio-record-page` is stale.** It expects a record page created in Studio to come back with regions copied from the default layout. Today a new record page is created slotted with no copied regions, by design, so `blocks.length` is 0.
- **`detail-related-list` is stale.** It expects a row click to navigate to `/record/`. Today the row's name link opens the record drawer, by design. The related-list behaviours it also touched are pinned by unit tests: `deriveRelatedLists.test.ts`, `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` and `RelatedList.columnIdentityAccessor.test.tsx`.
- **The MSW clause.** The vacuous MSW test in `ui/e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts` was already deleted by #26032, so that part of the premise no longer holds. What was left was four ignore entries (`mockServiceWorker`, `MSW`, `Mock Service Worker`, `[MSW]`) that still excused MSW console errors. They are removed: the Console ships no mock service worker, so an MSW error is now a real error. No `msw` declaration and no `public/mockServiceWorker.js` are left in the tree.
- **Platform checklist.** Every line that cited a deleted spec was repointed or dropped. Each item gets a revision bump and a `history` entry dated 2026-10-28, with ref #25914.

  | Item | Revision | Line | Edit |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` | 6→7 | acceptance[2].verify | now says the PUT is hand-driven, with no live spec pinning it |
  | `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` | 6→7 | automated.ref | the studio-record-page half is dropped |
  | `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` | 9→10 | verify parenthetical | dropped |
  | `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` | 9→10 | ref | the detail-related-list sentence is dropped |
  | `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` | 9→10 | live browser legs | acceptance[2] joins them |
  | `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` | 9→10 | history | cites the three unit pins above |
  | `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` | 9→10 | verify parenthetical | dropped |
  | `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` | 9→10 | ref | keeps only `studio-editor`, now nightly, which covers none of acceptance[0], [2] or [3] |
  | `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` | 9→10 | source line | dropped |
  | `studio-authoring.custom-page-render-and-blocks` | 1→2 | knownGaps / source | repointed to `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts`; that nightly smoke includes the pages named |
  | `studio-authoring.page-variables-and-actions` | 1→2 | knownGaps / source | same repoint |
  | `studio-authoring.custom-page-source-tiers` | 4→5 | knownGaps / source | same repoint |

- **Out of scope, flagged for the ledger owner.** `platform-core` acceptance[2] and `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` acceptance[0] still ask for regions "seeded from the default layout". That now holds only for `full` pages. The two history entries say so; the acceptance text is left as it is.

## Why

Ruling Q3 B (6435339772): the stale specs are deleted and the rest are wired into Nightly Tiers, so a red files a card. The other clauses of the card are already closed:
- Q1 A and ruling D were landed by the devx lane (#27167, #27212 via #27154).
- The MSW test went in #26032.

This PR closes the last one, hence `Fixes`.

## Verification

- The 18-spec measurement held the verify lock for 4m45s with `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The per-spec results are in the table above.
- The wrapper ran end to end: `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` gave Playwright 25 passed (1.7 min) and vitest 1 passed. It held the lock for 4m27s with VERDICT 0.
- `ui/e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts` ran in Chromium against a `/console/` build: 3 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 55 commands at the merge of `origin/main` `0d45c0e7`. To those I added:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`
  - `node scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --check`
  - `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`

  All 58 exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
  `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 1 and 3 on the first pass for the same reason. Both read built output this worktree had not built: console `plugin.d.ts`, and the `dist` of 7 packages this diff does not touch. Each exited 0 after the build of those packages (`build:plugin` for the console, then `turbo run build`).
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: "no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)". Changed lines: 514 (+275 / -239), under the 800 cap.
- This is test and CI only, so it ships no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (The root eslint, run over the two changed TypeScript files, exits 0.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (Except the `维护者速读` block the dispatch order asks for.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
